finalText:
**Build passes now, exit 0.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | Bundler renamed `retries` to `retryCount` | Read either key |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | New loader leaves unset flags `undefined`, check threw | Treat unset as off |

The 8 remaining warnings are real deprecations, not noise. `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js` is flagged for removal before v5. That is the next thing to fix.
